name: dev-spec
title: 开发需求规格化
description: 将需求对话、需求文档、API 文档、本地 PDF/DOCX 和原型图整理为证据化 spec，按业务闭环拆分实施步骤输出到 docs；OPC 流程下显式消费 product-lifecycle 三类 handoff 材料（需求记录/演示原型/DESIGN.md）+ prototype_pages + open_questions，按 dev_projects.kind 调整消费权重；intake 确定 feature 后建立活动状态文件与指针。Turn requirement materials into evidence-backed specs; explicitly consumes product-lifecycle three-type handoff materials under OPC flow with kind-weighted consumption; seeds the active per-feature state on intake.
